narr: A cluster of slow-moving thunderstorms developed along a cold front during the evening, producing isolated wind damage and flash flooding south of I-70.
ev: Some flooding of secondary roads from 9 to 930 PM from thunderstorms with heavy rains on south and southeast side of Oblong.
lsr: SOME FLOODING OF SECONDARY ROADS FROM 9 TO 930 PM FROM THUNDERSTORMS WITH HEAVY RAINS ON SOUTH AND SOUTHEAST SIDE OF OBLONG..
